  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

  [2/4] Step 2 of 4 – Set up the shared key

  HA NOVA keeps two kinds of access apart:
    a) This key lets this computer talk to the NOVA App
    b) The NOVA App gets its own Home Assistant access by itself

  NOVA Relay in your own container? Its Home Assistant token (HA_LLAT) stays there. Setup never asks for it.

  How do you want to set up the shared key (Relay Auth Token)?

    1) Paste a key from another computer or from Home Assistant
    2) Make a new key

  Enter [1-2] (default 2, or type 'back'/'exit'): 
  Here is your new key:
    <token>

  Next, on the NOVA App page:
    1. Open the "Configuration" tab
    2. Paste the key into the "Relay Auth Token" field
    3. Click Save
    4. Restart the App so it uses the new key

  This will open:
      <ha-url>/_my_redirect/supervisor_addon?addon=2368fcfa_ha_nova_relay

  Press Enter to open your browser:   Opening in your browser...

  Press Enter after you saved the key and restarted the NOVA App:
